zh.title: 优化
items:
更新弹窗的「更新内容」现在支持富文本展示，不再出现 `

` 等原始标签。
发布说明改为按版本维护，发布前会自动校验，确保每个版本都有清晰的更新内容。

zh.title: 修复
items: 修复自动更新下载失败（404）的问题：此前更新清单中的下载链接与实际安装包文件名不一致，导致无法下载新版本。
修复「发现新版本」弹窗中更新内容显示为 HTML 源码的问题。

en.title: Improvements
items:
Release notes in the update modal now render as rich text instead of raw tags like `

`.
Release notes are maintained per version and validated before publish so every release has clear update content.

en.title: Fixes
items: Fixed auto-update download failures (404) caused by mismatched download URLs and installer filenames in the update manifest.
Fixed the “New version available” modal showing release notes as raw HTML source.
